response.rationale: Both answers are usable, but the relation label is misleading: this is a shared synonym/preference contrast, not a genuinely different common-word distinction. Indonesian also uses “kipas” in relevant contexts, while Malaysian “kipas” can be clarified as “kipas angin” or “kipas elektrik” when needed. No false-friend contrast is present.
